full_text_zh:
[P1] 眼镜公主
文·图 张丽洁

[P2] 从前有一个公主，她是胖国王和瘦皇后的女儿。

[P3] 最近她好像怪怪的，先是把橘子当成网球打，
喷得大家一脸橘子汁。

[P4] 又把小羊当小狗，
拿着骨头喂羊吃。

[P5] 还把外婆当成了皇后，
公主说：“她们的头发看起来
一模一样嘛！”

[P6] 接着，公主把7看成了9，搭错了公交车。

[P7] 上课时，又把 3 看成 8，
惹得全班哈哈大笑。

[P8] 公主心里很难过，不知道要怎么办。

[P9] 皇后找了医生来，医生说：“公主可能有点近视，
也有点散光哦！我来帮她仔细检查看看。”

[P10] 国王说：“难怪公主最近常说眼睛累，
看东西都凑得很近。”

[P11] 皇后说：“难怪公主常揉眼睛，
也常眯着眼看东西。”

[P12] 医生说：“公主一定是常常
在光线不足的地方看书，
躺着看书看太久，

[P13] 还有，电视看太久也不休息。

[P14] 检查后，医生说：“还好，公主只是假性近视，多让眼睛休息就好了。不过，公主还有散光，得先戴眼镜矫正一下。”

[P15] 公主试了半天，
终于找到一副喜欢的眼镜。

[P16] 公主戴上了粉红色小眼镜，
哇！东西看得好清楚哟。

[P17] 大家笑着说：“我们的公主，是个眼镜公主！”

[P18] 公主很不习惯戴眼镜，
因为重重的眼镜
总是压得鼻子红红的。

[P19] 有时候，
从冷气房里出来，
镜片上都是雾气。

喝热汤时，
眼镜上一片水汽，
什么都看不清楚。

[P20] 做运动的时候，怕眼镜掉下来，

下大雨时，真希望镜片上有两个小雨刷呢！

游泳时，根本不能戴眼镜！

[P21] 公主想让眼睛变好，请大家一起来想办法。
医生说：“公主可以做做眼睛体操，
多让眼睛休息。”
眼球
向右停五秒
回到中间
停一下
眼球
向左停五秒
回到中间
停一下

[P22] 眼球
向上停五秒

回到中间
停一下

眼球
向下停五秒

回到中间
停一下

[P23] “还有眨眼睛运动。”
用力
闭上你的双眼
再把眼睛——
一下子睁开！

[P24] 厨师说：“让我来煮一些胡萝卜、绿色蔬菜吧。这些菜对公主的眼睛应该有帮助！”

[P25] 国王说：“看书光线要充足，睡眠要足够。”

[P26] 皇后说：“还要多做户外运动，多看看远的地方。”

[P27] 公主照着大家的建议做。过了一阵子，
医生说：“公主进步很快，不必再戴眼镜了，
记得定期检查视力哦！”

[P28] 公主眼睛变好了，东西全都看得很清楚，
真是方便极了！

[P29] 大家都高兴地说：“我们的公主，眼睛真明亮！”

[P30] 公主好高兴，决定把她的粉红色小眼镜挂在墙上，
提醒自己——要爱护眼睛哦！
full_text_en:
[P1] Glasses Princess
Text & Illustrations by Zhang Lijie

[P2] Once upon a time, there was a princess. She was the daughter of a fat king and a thin queen.

[P3] Recently, she's been acting strangely. First, she hit an orange like a tennis ball,
spattering everyone with orange juice.

[P4] Then she treated the little sheep like a puppy,
holding a bone to feed the sheep.

[P5] She even mistook her grandmother for the queen.
Princess said: "Their hair looks exactly the same!"

[P6] Next, the princess mistook 7 for 9 and got on the wrong bus.

[P7] During class, she again mistook 3 for 8,
which made the whole class laugh heartily.

[P8] The princess felt very sad and didn't know what to do.

[P9] The queen called in a doctor, who said: "The princess might have a bit of nearsightedness,
and some astigmatism too! I'll give her a thorough check-up."

[P10] The king said: "No wonder the princess has been saying her eyes are tired lately, 
she always gets so close to things when she looks at them."

[P11] The queen said, "No wonder the princess often rubs her eyes,
and often squints when looking at things."

[P12] The doctor said: "The princess must often read
in places with insufficient light,
and read while lying down for too long,

[P13] Also, watching TV for too long without resting.

[P14] After the examination, the doctor said: "Fortunately, the princess only has pseudomyopia; she just needs to rest her eyes more. However, the princess also has astigmatism, so she needs to wear glasses for correction first."

[P15] The princess tried for a long time,
and finally found a pair of glasses she liked.

[P16] The princess put on her pink little glasses,
Wow! Everything is so clear now.

[P17] Everyone laughed and said, "Our princess is a glasses princess!"

[P18] The princess was not used to wearing glasses,
because the heavy glasses
always pressed her nose until it turned red.

[P19] Sometimes,
when coming out of an air-conditioned room,
the lenses are covered in fog.

When drinking hot soup,
the glasses are full of steam,
and nothing is clear.

[P20] When exercising, I'm afraid my glasses will fall off.

When it's raining heavily, I really wish there were two little wipers on the lenses!

When swimming, I simply can't wear glasses!

[P21] The princess wants to improve her eyesight. Let's all think of ways together.
Doctor says: "The princess can do eye exercises,
and give her eyes more rest."
Eyeball
Look right and hold for five seconds
Return to center
Pause for a moment
Eyeball
Look left and hold for five seconds
Return to center
Pause for a moment

[P22] Eyeballs
Look up and hold for five seconds

Return to center
Pause for a moment

Eyeballs
Look down and hold for five seconds

Return to center
Pause for a moment

[P23] "There's also eye blinking exercises."
Use force
Close your eyes
Then open your eyes—
All at once!

[P24] The chef said, "Let me cook some carrots and green vegetables. These should help the princess's eyes!"

[P25] The king said, "Make sure you have enough light when reading, and get enough sleep."

[P26] The queen said, "You should also do more outdoor activities and look at distant places."

[P27] The princess followed everyone's advice. After a while,
the doctor said: "You've improved quickly, Princess. You don't need to wear glasses anymore.
Remember to check your eyesight regularly!"

[P28] The princess's eyes got better, and she could see everything clearly.
It was really convenient!

[P29] Everyone happily said, "Our princess, your eyes are so bright!"

[P30] The princess is so happy that she decides to hang her pink little glasses on the wall,
reminding herself — to take good care of her eyes!
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《眼镜公主》的封面，中央是一位戴眼镜、戴皇冠的红发公主，周围环绕着各种表情生动的角色，右上角标注作者为张丽洁。
[P2] 本页介绍了故事的主角——一位公主，她是胖国王和瘦皇后的孩子，画面中公主站在聚光灯下，父母在两侧微笑注视。
[P3] 公主把橘子当成网球打，导致橘子汁四溅，弄脏了周围的人和小动物。
[P4] 公主把小羊当作小狗，拿着骨头喂它们吃，画面中她正笑着向两只小羊递出骨头，背景是城堡和草地。
[P5] 公主把外婆误认为是皇后，因为她们的头发看起来一模一样。
[P6] 公主把数字7看成9，误上了777路公交车，与同伴一起奔跑追赶，但公交车已驶离。
[P7] 在课堂上，公主把数字3看成8，引起全班同学大笑，老师和同学们都在注视着她。
[P8] 公主感到很难过，不知道该怎么办，她双手托腮，表情忧愁，周围有小羊、小猪和玩具陪伴。
[P9] 皇后请来医生为公主检查视力，医生判断公主可能有近视和散光，并表示要仔细检查。
[P10] 国王注意到公主看书时总是凑得很近，因此推测她眼睛累了。
[P11] 皇后观察到公主经常揉眼睛和眯眼看东西，对此表示理解。
[P12] 医生分析公主视力问题的原因，认为她可能经常在光线不足的地方或躺着看书。
[P13] 医生指出公主视力问题的另一个原因是长时间看电视而不休息，画面中公主低头难过，皇后在一旁安慰，背景中有人在看电视吃零食。
[P14] 医生检查后告知公主患有假性近视和散光，建议她多休息眼睛并佩戴眼镜矫正。画面展示了公主尝试多种不同款式的眼镜。
[P15] 公主尝试了多种不同款式的眼镜，最终找到了一副自己喜欢的。
[P16] 公主戴上了粉红色的小眼镜，感到眼前的世界变得清晰明亮，她和周围的人开心地挥手庆祝。
[P17] 公主戴上新眼镜后，大家笑着称她为“眼镜公主”，她开心地站在众人中间，周围的人们纷纷围观并露出笑容。
[P18] 公主戴上新眼镜后感到不适，因为眼镜太重，压得鼻子发红，她对着镜子露出苦恼的表情。
[P19] 公主戴上新眼镜后，遇到两个生活中的小麻烦：从冷气房出来时镜片起雾，喝热汤时眼镜被水汽模糊，导致看不清东西。
[P20] 公主戴上眼镜后，在运动、下雨和游泳时遇到了使用上的困扰，担心眼镜掉落、起雾或无法佩戴。
[P21] 公主希望改善视力，医生建议她做眼睛体操并多休息眼睛，页面展示了左右移动眼球的简单眼保健操步骤。
[P22] 本页展示了眼保健操的两个步骤：眼球向上看五秒后回到中间暂停，再向下看五秒后回到中间暂停。
[P23] 医生指导公主进行眨眼睛运动，公主按照指示用力闭上双眼，再一下子睁开。
[P24] 厨师为公主准备胡萝卜和绿色蔬菜，认为这些食物对改善视力有帮助。
[P25] 国王建议公主看书时要保证光线充足，并且要保证充足的睡眠，画面左侧公主在灯下读书，右侧公主在床铺上安睡。
[P26] 皇后建议公主多做户外运动，多看看远处，画面中公主在草地上奔跑，国王和皇后在一旁观看。
[P27] 公主按照大家的建议改善视力，经过一段时间后，医生检查发现她视力进步很快，已无需佩戴眼镜，并提醒她定期检查视力。
[P28] 公主视力恢复后，能清楚看到东西，感到非常方便，画面展示了她吃饭、喂狗和认出远处车辆的三个场景。
[P29] 公主视力恢复后，大家为她明亮的眼睛感到高兴，纷纷称赞她。
[P30] 公主视力恢复后非常高兴，决定把她的粉红色小眼镜挂在墙上，作为提醒自己爱护眼睛的标志。
